caption: The drawing depicts a quilt made up of various square and triangular patches, each with different patterns and colors, predominantly featuring reds, oranges, browns, and blacks. Several patches have paisley designs in orange and white on dark backgrounds, while others display geometric patterns such as diagonal stripes, small flowers, dots, and grids in black, white, and red. At the center of the quilt, there is a realistic drawing of an orange tabby cat with detailed facial features, wearing a bow around its neck. In the lower corners of the quilt, there are two small, detailed monochrome sketches of dog heads facing slightly towards the center. The overall composition is rectangular and the edges of the quilt are slightly irregular, suggesting it is a fabric piece. The drawing is signed by the artist in the bottom right corner outside the quilt area.
title: Printed Cotton
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
